Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class StoryGraphTool

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
Direct Known Subclasses:
Explore, Generate, SimpleStoryGraphTool
public abstract class StoryGraphTool extends Object implements edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
A parent class for story graph tools that provides some basic utilities for parsing command line arguments and printing help text.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • checkVersion

      public static void checkVersion(edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraph graph)
      Compares the version number of the story graph library being used by this tool to the version number of the library used to create the given story graph, and if they do not match, prints a warning to the console. Note that this method does not check the version number of this tool, only the version number of the story graph library used to read, write, and modify the story graph.
      Parameters:
      graph - the story graph whose version will be checked

    • run

      public void run()
      This method runs this tool as a story graph task.

      This method is likely to be overridden, but by default it:

      • Checks if there are no arguments or if the help option is present, and if so, prints the help text and terminates.
      • Prints the title of the tool.
      • Runs this tools as a task.
      • Catches anything throwable and, if one is caught, prints its message.
